CREATE TABLE ledger_assets (
        asset TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scale INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (scale BETWEEN 0 AND 18))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_assets_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'asset scales are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_assets_no_update
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'asset scales are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_balances (
        account TEXT NOT NULL, asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset),
        units TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (account, asset))

CREATE TABLE ledger_events (
        sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        event_hash TEXT NOT NULL, sealed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sealed IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_seal_only
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_events
        WHEN OLD.sealed != 0 OR NEW.sealed != 1 OR NEW.sequence != OLD.sequence
          OR NEW.event_id != OLD.event_id OR NEW.fingerprint != OLD.fingerprint
          OR NEW.previous_hash != OLD.previous_hash OR NEW.event_hash != OLD.event_hash
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_postings (
        sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_events(sequence),
        ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), account TEXT NOT NULL,
        asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset), units TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (sequence, ordinal))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_no_update
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_unsealed_only
        BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_postings
        WHEN (SELECT sealed FROM ledger_events WHERE sequence = NEW.sequence) != 0
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is sealed'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_schema (
        singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
        version INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE uta_accounts (account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version >= 0))

CREATE TABLE uta_authority (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('exchange','research')))
CREATE TABLE uta_code_artifacts (artifact_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,manifest TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE uta_command_config (
                singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), format INTEGER NOT NULL,
                queue_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL, cancel_reserve INTEGER NOT NULL, market_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_config_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON uta_command_config BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'inbox config is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_config_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_command_config BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'inbox config is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE uta_command_inbox (
                sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, command_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                account_id TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('PENDING','SUCCEEDED','REJECTED','QUARANTINED')),
                result TEXT, error TEXT, enqueued_at TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at TEXT,
                attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT, next_attempt_at TEXT)

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_command_inbox WHEN NEW.sequence!=OLD.sequence OR NEW.command_id!=OLD.command_id OR NEW.account_id IS NOT OLD.account_id OR NEW.kind!=OLD.kind OR NEW.payload!=OLD.payload OR NEW.enqueued_at!=OLD.enqueued_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command identity is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON uta_command_inbox BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command history is retained'); END

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON uta_command_inbox WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM uta_command_inbox WHERE command_id=NEW.command_id OR sequence=NEW.sequence) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command identity cannot be replaced'); END

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_pending_insert BEFORE INSERT ON uta_command_inbox WHEN NEW.state!='PENDING' OR NEW.result IS NOT NULL OR NEW.error IS NOT NULL OR NEW.completed_at IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'new commands must be pending without a terminal receipt'); END
CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_terminal_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_command_inbox WHEN OLD.state!='PENDING' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'terminal command receipt is immutable'); END
CREATE TABLE uta_config (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE uta_deposits (
                account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id), event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                asset TEXT NOT NULL, amount TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(account_id,event_id))

CREATE TABLE uta_events (
                sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                account_id TEXT, payload TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER uta_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON uta_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'events are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER uta_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'events are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE uta_fills (
                account_id TEXT NOT NULL, fill_id TEXT NOT NULL, order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                quantity TEXT NOT NULL, price TEXT NOT NULL, realized_pnl TEXT NOT NULL, fee TEXT NOT NULL, execution_decision_id TEXT REFERENCES uta_risk_decisions(decision_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
                PRIMARY KEY(account_id,fill_id), FOREIGN KEY(account_id,order_id) REFERENCES uta_orders(account_id,order_id))

CREATE TABLE uta_liabilities (
                account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id), asset TEXT NOT NULL,
                principal TEXT NOT NULL, interest TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(account_id,asset))

CREATE TABLE uta_liquidation_accounts (
                account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id),
                state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('NORMAL','LIQUIDATING','BANKRUPT','BLOCKED')),
                cycle INTEGER NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
                plan_market_version INTEGER, plan_position_digest TEXT)
CREATE TABLE uta_market (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), payload TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE uta_market_history (snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,content_digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,payload TEXT NOT NULL,origin TEXT NOT NULL,recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE uta_orders (
                account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id), order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                symbol TEXT NOT NULL, quantity TEXT NOT NULL, limit_price TEXT NOT NULL,
                reduce_only INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reduce_only IN (0,1)),
                filled_quantity TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('OPEN','PARTIALLY_FILLED','FILLED','CANCELLED')),
                version INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, fee_notional TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', charged_fee TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', admission_decision_id TEXT REFERENCES uta_risk_decisions(decision_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
                PRIMARY KEY(account_id,order_id))

CREATE TABLE uta_positions (
                account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id), symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
                quantity TEXT NOT NULL, cost_basis TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (account_id,symbol))

CREATE TABLE uta_risk_decisions (decision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id),business_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    market_snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_market_history(snapshot_id),
                    artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_code_artifacts(artifact_id),
                    policy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_risk_policies(policy_id),pre_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    post_version INTEGER NOT NULL,recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,input_payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    summary_payload TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(kind,account_id,business_id))
CREATE TABLE uta_risk_policies (policy_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,payload TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE uta_schema (version INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE writer_fence_authority (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),format INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(format=1),authority_id TEXT NOT NULL,canonical_path TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER writer_fence_authority_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON writer_fence_authority BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'fence authority and audit are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER writer_fence_authority_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON writer_fence_authority BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'fence authority and audit are immutable'); END

        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_events
        WHEN OLD.sealed != 0 OR NEW.sealed != 1 OR NEW.sequence != OLD.sequence

          OR NEW.previous_hash != OLD.previous_hash OR NEW.event_hash != OLD.event_hash
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_events (
        sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        event_hash TEXT NOT NULL, sealed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sealed IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_seal_only
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_events
        WHEN OLD.sealed != 0 OR NEW.sealed != 1 OR NEW.sequence != OLD.sequence
          OR NEW.event_id != OLD.event_id OR NEW.fingerprint != OLD.fingerprint
          OR NEW.previous_hash != OLD.previous_hash OR NEW.event_hash != OLD.event_hash
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

        sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_events(sequence),

        PRIMARY KEY (sequence, ordinal))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_no_update
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_unsealed_only
        BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_postings
        WHEN (SELECT sealed FROM ledger_events WHERE sequence = NEW.sequence) != 0
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is sealed'); END

CREATE TABLE credit_commands (
                scope TEXT NOT NULL, command_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset), amount TEXT NOT NULL,
                source_reference TEXT, result TEXT NOT NULL,
                journal_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES ledger_events(event_id),
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(scope,command_id))
CREATE TRIGGER credit_commands_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON credit_commands BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'credit commands are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER credit_commands_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON credit_commands BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'credit commands are immutable'); END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX credit_pool_source_unique ON credit_commands(source_reference) WHERE kind='pool_funded'
CREATE TABLE credit_schema (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), version INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE ledger_assets (
        asset TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scale INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (scale BETWEEN 0 AND 18))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_assets_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'asset scales are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_assets_no_update
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'asset scales are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_balances (
        account TEXT NOT NULL, asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset),
        units TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (account, asset))

CREATE TABLE ledger_events (
        sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        event_hash TEXT NOT NULL, sealed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sealed IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_seal_only
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_events
        WHEN OLD.sealed != 0 OR NEW.sealed != 1 OR NEW.sequence != OLD.sequence
          OR NEW.event_id != OLD.event_id OR NEW.fingerprint != OLD.fingerprint
          OR NEW.previous_hash != OLD.previous_hash OR NEW.event_hash != OLD.event_hash
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_postings (
        sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_events(sequence),
        ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), account TEXT NOT NULL,
        asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset), units TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (sequence, ordinal))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_no_update
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_unsealed_only
        BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_postings
        WHEN (SELECT sealed FROM ledger_events WHERE sequence = NEW.sequence) != 0
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is sealed'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_schema (
        singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
        version INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE uta_accounts (account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version >= 0))

CREATE TABLE uta_audit_capability (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),format INTEGER NOT NULL,enabled_at TEXT NOT NULL,legacy_event_watermark INTEGER NOT NULL,legacy_order_count INTEGER NOT NULL,legacy_fill_count INTEGER NOT NULL,gaps TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE uta_authority (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('exchange','research')))
CREATE TABLE uta_code_artifacts (artifact_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,manifest TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE uta_command_config (
                singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), format INTEGER NOT NULL,
                queue_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL, cancel_reserve INTEGER NOT NULL, market_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_config_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON uta_command_config BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'inbox config is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_config_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON uta_command_config WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM uta_command_config WHERE singleton=NEW.singleton) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'inbox config cannot be replaced'); END
CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_config_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_command_config BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'inbox config is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE uta_command_inbox (
                sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, command_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                account_id TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('PENDING','SUCCEEDED','REJECTED','QUARANTINED')),
                result TEXT, error TEXT, enqueued_at TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at TEXT,
                attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT, next_attempt_at TEXT)

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_command_inbox WHEN NEW.sequence!=OLD.sequence OR NEW.command_id!=OLD.command_id OR NEW.account_id IS NOT OLD.account_id OR NEW.kind!=OLD.kind OR NEW.payload!=OLD.payload OR NEW.enqueued_at!=OLD.enqueued_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command identity is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON uta_command_inbox BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command history is retained'); END

      WHEN NEW.account LIKE 'system:credit-%' OR NEW.account LIKE 'liability:principal:%'
        OR NEW.account LIKE 'liability:interest:%'
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM credit_native_intents i JOIN ledger_events e ON e.event_id=i.journal_id WHERE e.sequence=NEW.sequence)
      BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM credit_native_intents i JOIN ledger_events e ON e.event_id=i.journal_id
        JOIN credit_native_expected_postings x ON x.command_id=i.command_id WHERE e.sequence=NEW.sequence
        AND x.ordinal=NEW.ordinal AND x.account=NEW.account AND x.asset=NEW.asset AND x.units=NEW.units
        AND uta_credit_operation_v1('POSTING',i.command_id,i.intent_digest)=1)
        THEN RAISE(ABORT,'actual authorized complete credit postings required') END; END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_native_record_gate BEFORE INSERT ON credit_commands BEGIN
      SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM credit_native_intents i JOIN ledger_events e ON e.event_id=i.journal_id AND e.sealed=1
        WHERE i.command_id=NEW.command_id AND i.scope=NEW.scope AND i.credit_kind=NEW.kind AND i.asset=NEW.asset
        AND i.amount=NEW.amount AND i.journal_id=NEW.journal_event_id
        AND uta_credit_operation_v1('CREDIT_RECORD',i.command_id,i.intent_digest)=1
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM credit_native_expected_postings x WHERE x.command_id=i.command_id)=i.expected_postings
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ledger_postings p WHERE p.sequence=e.sequence)=i.expected_postings
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM credit_native_expected_postings x WHERE x.command_id=i.command_id AND NOT EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM ledger_postings p WHERE p.sequence=e.sequence AND p.ordinal=x.ordinal AND p.account=x.account AND p.asset=x.asset AND p.units=x.units)))
        THEN RAISE(ABORT,'authorized sealed credit closing point required') END; END

CREATE TABLE credit_native_intents(
      command_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,account_id TEXT NOT NULL,scope TEXT NOT NULL,
      operation_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation_kind IN ('BORROW','REPAY')),
      inbox_kind TEXT NOT NULL,credit_kind TEXT NOT NULL,asset TEXT NOT NULL,
      amount TEXT NOT NULL,units TEXT NOT NULL,payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,intent_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
      journal_id TEXT NOT NULL,sealed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(sealed)='integer' AND sealed=1),
      decision_id TEXT,decision_kind TEXT,terminal_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(terminal_state='SUCCEEDED'),
      allocation_id TEXT NOT NULL,authority_id TEXT NOT NULL,policy_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_id TEXT NOT NULL,expected_postings INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expected_postings IN (4,7)),
      old_principal TEXT NOT NULL,old_interest TEXT NOT NULL,new_principal TEXT NOT NULL,new_interest TEXT NOT NULL,
      CHECK(scope='account:'||account_id),
      CHECK((operation_kind='BORROW' AND inbox_kind='BORROW' AND credit_kind='borrowed' AND expected_postings=4
        AND decision_id IS NOT NULL AND decision_kind IS NOT NULL AND decision_kind='CREDIT_BORROWED')
        OR(operation_kind='REPAY' AND inbox_kind='REPAY' AND credit_kind='repaid' AND decision_id IS NULL AND decision_kind IS NULL)),
      FOREIGN KEY(command_id,account_id,inbox_kind,terminal_state) REFERENCES uta_command_inbox(command_id,account_id,kind,state) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
      FOREIGN KEY(scope,command_id,credit_kind,asset,amount,journal_id) REFERENCES credit_commands(scope,command_id,kind,asset,amount,journal_event_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
      FOREIGN KEY(decision_id,decision_kind,account_id,command_id) REFERENCES uta_risk_decisions(decision_id,kind,account_id,business_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
      FOREIGN KEY(journal_id,sealed) REFERENCES ledger_events(event_id,sealed) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
      FOREIGN KEY(allocation_id,authority_id,asset) REFERENCES credit_native_allocations(allocation_id,authority_id,asset) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
      FOREIGN KEY(policy_id) REFERENCES credit_native_policies(policy_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
      FOREIGN KEY(source_id,command_id,account_id,payload_hash) REFERENCES credit_native_sources(source_id,command_id,account_id,payload_hash) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TRIGGER credit_native_posting_gate BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_postings
      WHEN NEW.account LIKE 'system:credit-%' OR NEW.account LIKE 'liability:principal:%'
        OR NEW.account LIKE 'liability:interest:%'
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM credit_native_intents i JOIN ledger_events e ON e.event_id=i.journal_id WHERE e.sequence=NEW.sequence)
      BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM credit_native_intents i JOIN ledger_events e ON e.event_id=i.journal_id
        JOIN credit_native_expected_postings x ON x.command_id=i.command_id WHERE e.sequence=NEW.sequence
        AND x.ordinal=NEW.ordinal AND x.account=NEW.account AND x.asset=NEW.asset AND x.units=NEW.units
        AND uta_credit_operation_v1('POSTING',i.command_id,i.intent_digest)=1)
        THEN RAISE(ABORT,'actual authorized complete credit postings required') END; END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_native_record_gate BEFORE INSERT ON credit_commands BEGIN
      SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM credit_native_intents i JOIN ledger_events e ON e.event_id=i.journal_id AND e.sealed=1
        WHERE i.command_id=NEW.command_id AND i.scope=NEW.scope AND i.credit_kind=NEW.kind AND i.asset=NEW.asset
        AND i.amount=NEW.amount AND i.journal_id=NEW.journal_event_id
        AND uta_credit_operation_v1('CREDIT_RECORD',i.command_id,i.intent_digest)=1
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM credit_native_expected_postings x WHERE x.command_id=i.command_id)=i.expected_postings
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ledger_postings p WHERE p.sequence=e.sequence)=i.expected_postings
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM credit_native_expected_postings x WHERE x.command_id=i.command_id AND NOT EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM ledger_postings p WHERE p.sequence=e.sequence AND p.ordinal=x.ordinal AND p.account=x.account AND p.asset=x.asset AND p.units=x.units)))
        THEN RAISE(ABORT,'authorized sealed credit closing point required') END; END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_assets_no_update
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'asset scales are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_balances (

        units TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (account, asset))

CREATE TABLE ledger_events (
        sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        event_hash TEXT NOT NULL, sealed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sealed IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_seal_only
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_events
        WHEN OLD.sealed != 0 OR NEW.sealed != 1 OR NEW.sequence != OLD.sequence
          OR NEW.event_id != OLD.event_id OR NEW.fingerprint != OLD.fingerprint
          OR NEW.previous_hash != OLD.previous_hash OR NEW.event_hash != OLD.event_hash
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_postings (
        sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_events(sequence),
        ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), account TEXT NOT NULL,
        asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset), units TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (sequence, ordinal))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_no_update
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_unsealed_only
        BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_postings
        WHEN (SELECT sealed FROM ledger_events WHERE sequence = NEW.sequence) != 0
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is sealed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_command_inbox WHEN NEW.sequence!=OLD.sequence OR NEW.command_id!=OLD.command_id OR NEW.account_id IS NOT OLD.account_id OR NEW.kind!=OLD.kind OR NEW.payload!=OLD.payload OR NEW.enqueued_at!=OLD.enqueued_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command identity is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON uta_command_inbox BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command history is retained'); END

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON uta_command_inbox WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM uta_command_inbox WHERE command_id=NEW.command_id OR sequence=NEW.sequence) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command identity cannot be replaced'); END

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_terminal_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_command_inbox WHEN OLD.state!='PENDING' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'terminal command receipt is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_commands_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON credit_commands BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'credit commands are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE credit_schema (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), version INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE ledger_assets (
        asset TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scale INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (scale BETWEEN 0 AND 18))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_assets_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'asset scales are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_assets_no_update
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'asset scales are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_balances (
        account TEXT NOT NULL, asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset),
        units TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (account, asset))

CREATE TABLE ledger_events (
        sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        event_hash TEXT NOT NULL, sealed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sealed IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_seal_only
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_events
        WHEN OLD.sealed != 0 OR NEW.sealed != 1 OR NEW.sequence != OLD.sequence
          OR NEW.event_id != OLD.event_id OR NEW.fingerprint != OLD.fingerprint
          OR NEW.previous_hash != OLD.previous_hash OR NEW.event_hash != OLD.event_hash
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_postings (
        sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_events(sequence),
        ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), account TEXT NOT NULL,
        asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset), units TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (sequence, ordinal))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_no_update
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_unsealed_only
        BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_postings
        WHEN (SELECT sealed FROM ledger_events WHERE sequence = NEW.sequence) != 0
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is sealed'); END

                singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), format INTEGER NOT NULL,
                queue_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL, cancel_reserve INTEGER NOT NULL, market_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_config_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON uta_command_config BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'inbox config is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_config_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_command_config BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'inbox config is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE uta_command_inbox (
                sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, command_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                account_id TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('PENDING','SUCCEEDED','REJECTED','QUARANTINED')),
                result TEXT, error TEXT, enqueued_at TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at TEXT,
                attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT, next_attempt_at TEXT)

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_command_inbox WHEN NEW.sequence!=OLD.sequence OR NEW.command_id!=OLD.command_id OR NEW.account_id IS NOT OLD.account_id OR NEW.kind!=OLD.kind OR NEW.payload!=OLD.payload OR NEW.enqueued_at!=OLD.enqueued_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command identity is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON uta_command_inbox BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command history is retained'); END

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON uta_command_inbox WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM uta_command_inbox WHERE command_id=NEW.command_id OR sequence=NEW.sequence) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command identity cannot be replaced'); END

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_pending_insert BEFORE INSERT ON uta_command_inbox WHEN NEW.state!='PENDING' OR NEW.result IS NOT NULL OR NEW.error IS NOT NULL OR NEW.completed_at IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'new commands must be pending without a terminal receipt'); END
CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_terminal_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_command_inbox WHEN OLD.state!='PENDING' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'terminal command receipt is immutable'); END

        asset TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scale INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (scale BETWEEN 0 AND 18))

        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'asset scales are immutable'); END

        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'asset scales are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_events (
        sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        event_hash TEXT NOT NULL, sealed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sealed IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_seal_only
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_events
        WHEN OLD.sealed != 0 OR NEW.sealed != 1 OR NEW.sequence != OLD.sequence
          OR NEW.event_id != OLD.event_id OR NEW.fingerprint != OLD.fingerprint
          OR NEW.previous_hash != OLD.previous_hash OR NEW.event_hash != OLD.event_hash
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE ledger_postings (
        sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_events(sequence),
        ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), account TEXT NOT NULL,
        asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset), units TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (sequence, ordinal))

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_no_delete
        BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_no_update
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_postings_unsealed_only
        BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_postings
        WHEN (SELECT sealed FROM ledger_events WHERE sequence = NEW.sequence) != 0
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is sealed'); END

                state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('PENDING','SUCCEEDED','REJECTED','QUARANTINED')),
                result TEXT, error TEXT, enqueued_at TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at TEXT,
                attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT, next_attempt_at TEXT)

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_command_inbox WHEN NEW.sequence!=OLD.sequence OR NEW.command_id!=OLD.command_id OR NEW.account_id IS NOT OLD.account_id OR NEW.kind!=OLD.kind OR NEW.payload!=OLD.payload OR NEW.enqueued_at!=OLD.enqueued_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command identity is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON uta_command_inbox BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command history is retained'); END

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON uta_command_inbox WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM uta_command_inbox WHERE command_id=NEW.command_id OR sequence=NEW.sequence) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'command identity cannot be replaced'); END

CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_pending_insert BEFORE INSERT ON uta_command_inbox WHEN NEW.state!='PENDING' OR NEW.result IS NOT NULL OR NEW.error IS NOT NULL OR NEW.completed_at IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'new commands must be pending without a terminal receipt'); END
CREATE TRIGGER uta_command_inbox_terminal_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON uta_command_inbox WHEN OLD.state!='PENDING' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'terminal command receipt is immutable'); END
